content: 1. Avoid coadministration of elagolix with other drugs unless the potential benefits outweigh the risks. When coadministered, hormonal contraceptives are not considered a reliable method of effective birth control. Concomitant use may increase the incidence of menstruation-associated adverse effects, such as amenorrhea, dysmenorrhea, and menorrhagia. 2. Elagolix decreases the plasma levels or efficacy of olutasidenib by inducing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider using an alternative drug. 3. Strong or moderate CYP3A inducers reduce the plasma concentration and efficacy of olutasidenib, a CYP3A4 substrate. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 4. Elagolix reduces the levels or effects of omaveloxolone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 5. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of palovarotene by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 6. Elagolix reduces the levels or effects of pemigatinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 7. Phenobarbital decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone acetate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 8. Phenytoin reduces the levels or effects of norethindrone acetate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 9. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of praziquantel by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 10. Primidone reduces the levels or effects of norethindrone acetate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 11. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone acetate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 12. Rifampin reduces the levels of norethindrone acetate by increasing its metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 13. Rifapentine decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone acetate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 14. Elagolix reduces the levels or effects of quizartinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 15. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of repotrectinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. It also increases the levels or effects of repotrectinib by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 16. Trofinetide increases the levels or effects of elagolix by inhibiting OATP1B1 and OATP1B3 transporters. Avoid coadministration with sensitive substrates. 17. Tucatinib increases the levels or effects of norethindrone acetate by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Avoid concomitant use of tucatinib with CYP3A substrates where minimal concentration changes may lead to serious toxicities. 18. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of selumetinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 19. Elagolix reduces the levels or effects of tazemetostat by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 20. Topiramate decreases the levels or effects of norethindrone acetate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 21. Elagolix reduces the levels or effects of rimegepant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. It also increases the levels or effects of rimegepant by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 22. Ritonavir increases the levels or effects of elagolix by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 23. Segesterone/ethinyl estradiol reduces the effects of elagolix through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 24. Estrogen-containing contraceptives are expected to reduce the efficacy of elagolix based on its mechanism of action. The effects of progestin-only contraceptives on elagolix efficacy are unknown. Advise women to use nonhormonal contraceptives during elagolix treatment and for one week after discontinuation. 25. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of vonoprazan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 26. Elagolix reduces the levels or effects of zanubrutinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, increase the zanubrutinib dose to 320 mg twice daily and resume the previous dose after discontinuing the CYP3A4 inducer. 27. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of zuranolone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 28. Elagolix reduces the levels or effects of abemaciclib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Elagolix is a weak-to-moderate CYP3A4 inducer. Monitor CYP3A substrates if coadministered and consider increasing the substrate dose if needed. 29. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of acalabrutinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 30. Elagolix reduces the levels or effects of ado-trastuzumab emtansine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 31. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of afatinib by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor. 32. Norethindrone acetate reduces the effects of albiglutide through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Use caution and monitor. 33. Oral contraceptives may impair glucose tolerance and reduce the hypoglycemic effects of antidiabetics. Monitor glycemic control in diabetic patients. 34. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of alfentanil by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 35. Elagolix reduces the levels or effects of aliskiren by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor. 36. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of alprazolam by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 37. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of ambrisentan by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism and the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor. 38. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of amiodarone by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism and the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. It also decreases the levels or effects of amiodarone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 39. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of amitriptyline by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor. 40. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of amlodipine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 41. Amobarbital reduces the levels or effects of elagolix by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 42. Apalutamide decreases the levels or effects of elagolix by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Elagolix also reduces the levels or effects of apalutamide by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 43. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of apixaban by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. It also decreases the levels or effects of apixaban by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 44. Elagolix reduces the levels or effects of apremilast by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 45. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of aprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 46. Elagolix reduces the levels or effects of aripiprazole by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 47. Armodafinil decreases the levels or effects of elagolix by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Elagolix also reduces the levels or effects of armodafinil by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 48. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of elagolix by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Coadministration of elagolix 200 mg twice daily with strong CYP3A inhibitors for more than one month is not recommended. 49. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of atogepant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. The recommended atogepant dosage with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers is 30 mg or 60 mg once daily. 50. Cenobamate reduces the levels or effects of norethindrone acetate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely.
